tag: the screening is copied into the validator instead of shared, so two screens can drift
why: L3. The mutation is the shape the shortcut would really take - a second verdict reached here rather than by the sandbox - and it still returns the right keys, so only driving the breach through the validator sees it. FU-363 refused this precisely because two copies of two heuristics drift.

tag: a heuristic that could not run is reported as having passed
why: L2, and it is the rule this programme states most often: a check that did not run is not a check that passed. With the mutation an output of no words scores 1.0 untouched - because the only heuristic that could have deducted is the one that could not run - and returns passed=True, the most confident possible verdict over the least possible evidence.

tag: the diversity heuristic divides by zero on an output with no words
why: L2. This is the PRE-EXISTING defect, restored: ZeroDivisionError on empty output, which uci_interceptor.py:90 did not guard. It was never reached before because the only caller passed model output; the constitutional validator reaches it with whatever the chain is given.

tag: checks_run is a constant list again, describing a run that may not have completed
why: L1 and L2. The constant is what was there before, and it asserted both heuristics always ran - untrue of an output with no words, which previously raised before reaching the dict at all. A list of checks is a claim about what happened, and only the screen knows.

tag: the clearance chain does not consult the enforcement pattern it constructs
why: L4, the state FU-364 names: the chain held a pattern with nineteen validators registered and never called validate on it. The mutation keeps the gate in place and makes it always clear, which is the way a gate stops being a gate without anyone noticing it has gone.

tag: an unassessable set of constraints is read as a clearance at the top of the stack
why: L4(a). This is the certifies-an-absence defect one level above the screens: with the mutation a breach still blocks, so the gate looks like it works, and a pattern reporting that fifteen of nineteen constraints have NO INSTRUMENT clears the chain. The leg drives the ordinary input, where the verdict is None rather than False.

tag: the pattern's own count is paraphrased instead of carried into the chain's reason
old: f"the constraints could not all be assessed, so the chain did not clear. {_enf_basis}"
new: "the constraints could not all be assessed, so the chain did not clear"
why: L4(a). A chain that restates a conclusion without the figures that produced it is a chain whose reason goes stale the moment the figures change - and the figures here are the whole content: how many of nineteen were assessed, how many have no instrument, and which lacked their input.

tag: a breach reaches the chain without the evidence for it
why: L4(b), and this defect was live until this round: zero_placeholder names the marker it found, and _handle_violation dropped the basis, so the chain's reason said a constraint was violated and stopped. The leg requires the marker text to survive all the way into ClearanceResult.reason.

why: L5, the pre-existing line restored. It was tolerable while nothing consulted the pattern and became a line on the live clearance path the moment gate 6 existed - unroutable, unfilterable, unsilenceable, and emitted once per refusal on a path whose ordinary outcome IS a refusal.
